# sealed class declarations

sealed class Shape permits Circle, Polygon {}
final class Circle extends Shape {}
non-sealed class Polygon extends Shape {}

==>

Program(
  ClassDeclaration(
    Modifiers(sealed),
    class,
    Definition,
    Permits(permits, InterfaceTypeList(TypeName, TypeName)),
    ClassBody),
  ClassDeclaration(
    Modifiers(final),
    class,
    Definition,
    Superclass(extends, TypeName),
    ClassBody),
  ClassDeclaration(
    Modifiers(non, sealed),
    class,
    Definition,
    Superclass(extends, TypeName),
    ClassBody))

# sealed interface declarations

sealed interface Shape permits Circle, Polygon {}
final class Circle implements Shape {}
non-sealed class Polygon implements Shape {}

==>

Program(
  InterfaceDeclaration(
    Modifiers(sealed),
    interface,
    Definition,
    Permits(permits, InterfaceTypeList(TypeName, TypeName)),
    InterfaceBody),
  ClassDeclaration(
    Modifiers(final),
    class,
    Definition,
    SuperInterfaces(implements, InterfaceTypeList(TypeName)),
    ClassBody),
  ClassDeclaration(
    Modifiers(non, sealed),
    class,
    Definition,
    SuperInterfaces(implements, InterfaceTypeList(TypeName)),
    ClassBody))

# contextual sealed words remain identifiers

class Contextual {
  int sealed;
  int non;
  int permits;
}

==>

Program(
  ClassDeclaration(
    class,
    Definition,
    ClassBody(
      FieldDeclaration(PrimitiveType, VariableDeclarator(Definition)),
      FieldDeclaration(PrimitiveType, VariableDeclarator(Definition)),
      FieldDeclaration(PrimitiveType, VariableDeclarator(Definition)))))
